passages.text:
Re: coms training with YT
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Monday, September 19, 2022 at 4:05:58 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Josh Blumenfeld
awesome
On Mon, Sep 19, 2022 at 3:56 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hey sorry for the delay. We've been troubling shooting the European cohort and finally found a solution! Should have
feedback on asia in next day or two!
On Mon, Sep 19, 2022 at 3:46 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
any news on response to internews and rdma
On Mon, Sep 19, 2022 at 10:51 AM Josh Blumenfeld [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Chelsea,
No worries at all, and totally get it. Hope you and the team are well.
Many thanks,
Josh
On Mon, Sep 19, 2022 at 10:49 AM Chelsea Milko <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Josh,
Thanks for reaching out again. We're going to press pause due to a busy season for our principals and some
personnel shifts. Will reach out once things quiet down a bit, perhaps later this fall.
V/R,
Chelsea Milko
Sr. Communications Advisor
USAID | Bureau for Latin America and the Caribbean
On Mon, Sep 19, 2022 at 10:10 AM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Chelsea,
Wanted to circle back on this to see if you have some potential times for the training for your teams in LAC.
Many thanks!
Josh
On Mon, Aug 15, 2022 at 8:22 PM Josh Blumenfeld [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Chelsea,
Absolutely, will do. Indeed, small world! Matt was in S/P when I was a DAS in H. We will revert asap on
the training and next steps.
Thanks again,
Josh
On Mon, Aug 15, 2022 at 12:35 PM Chelsea Milko <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Happy Monday, YT team,
Thanks again for chatting with LAC/Comms last week. Seems like such a useful opportunity for our
communicators in the field.
So cool that we have the Matt Walsh connection, Josh!
When you get a chance, please share whatever training overview details you have, both for beginners
who need a 101 tutorial and for those with more advanced skills who would like to use the platform more

strategically. With that info, I can run the traps internally just to make sure l've checked that box, and
gauge the interests of our in-region communications specialists, too!
Thank you!
Chelsea Milko
Sr. Communications Advisor
USAID | Bureau for Latin America and the Caribbean
On Wed, Aug 10, 2022 at 10:23 AM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
happy to!
On Tue, Aug 9, 2022 at 3:55 PM Chelsea Milko <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Sounds good! Would you mind sending the calendar invite?
Chelsea Milko
Sr. Communications Advisor
USAID | Bureau for Latin America and the Caribbean
On Tue, Aug 9, 2022 at 3:02 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Perfect! Shall we say 11:30am on Thursday?
On Tue, Aug 9, 2022 at 9:59 AM Chelsea Milko <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Yes--the Administrator's trip to Colombia was a success. Lots of work for us but always
rewarding.
Anytime Thursday between 11 am and 4 pm works for us. Thanks a ton!
Chelsea Milko
Sr. Comminications Advisor
USAID | Bureau for Latin America and the Caribbean
On Mon, Aug 8, 2022 at 4:46 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Chelsea,
Thanks so much for the note. It looked the Administrator valiantly represented the US in
Bogota! Yes, we'd love to connect on the "How YouTube Works" Training.
How does Thursday and Friday look for you all?
Many thanks,
Josh
On Mon, Aug 8, 2022 at 4:22 PM Chelsea Milko <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Josh,
The high-level trip is done and now 1 can turn back to other projects. Yay!
Do you havetime to chat this week about the training? Adding my LAC/Comms team mate,
Kayden McKenzie, for awareness.
Thanks!
Chelsea Milko
Sr. Communications Advisor
USAID | Bureau for Latin America and the Caribbean
On Mon, Aug 1, 2022 at 12:05 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
of course! good luck!

On Mon, Aug 1, 2022 at 12:05 PM Chelsea Milko <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks for following up! We're slammed with a high-level trip to the region. Can we
connect next week?
Appreciate it!
Chelsea Milko
Sr. Communications Advisor
USAID | Bureau for Latin America and the Caribbean
On Mon, Aug 1, 2022 at 11:58 AM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Chelsea,
Just circling back on this, let us know of some times that may work.
Many thanks,
Josh
On Thu, Jul 28, 2022 at 2:57 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
wrote:
Hi Vera, thanks for connecting us.
Chelsea, great to meet you. Any chance we can connect next week? I'm adding
in my colleague Emily, as well. Essentially, our civics team offers these trainings to
government partners across the USG (executive and legislative branch, in an non-
partisan manner) and Gov entities across the world, so they can better use
YouTube.
Happy to hop on the phone with you all to walk you through it, but most of our
civics partners have found these trainings to be extremely beneficial so they can
better use the platform. We recently hosted all US Senate Press Secretaries for a
similar training in New York.
Looking forward to connecting.
Many thanks,
Josh
On Thu, Jul 28, 2022 at 9:37 AM Chelsea Milko <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks a ton for the connection, Vera! We will keep you in the loop.
Josh, pleasure to meet you. We're interested to know more about the training
and what it entails. Do you have time for a quick chat tomorrow afternoon?
Thanks!
Chelsea Milko
Sr. Communications Advisor
USAID | Bureau for Latin America and the Caribbean
On Wed, Jul 27, 2022 at 6:45 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Chelsea,
Please meet Josh Blumenfeld with YouTube. Please connect to learn more
about the training that YT offers globally for communications professionals.
Josh - pls meet Chelsea in our Latin America division who covers public
affairs.
I'll let you guys set up a separate meeting - I don't need to be on it; just keep
me in the loop, pls.
